title: Clean, elegant, and purposeful.
body: Please don’t stop improving — you clearly understand what people want. Your sense of taste shows in every detail. Keep chasing simplicity and beauty — that’s the magic that sets this app apart.
author: aaalsubaie

title: Really good app that can be great
body: Really good app that can be great, Please just make the URLs in Habit description clickable, that is the only essential feature missing from the app, you could also add the ability to see apple calendar events at the top of today view(just simple list like the today view in Things 3 app)

title: Great app
body:
It’s the Most great app for habits I been used
Very easy to use on iPhone and Apple Watch, just one click on habit to complete.
It’s expensive a little bit
I hone to see a lot of features on The future, like deadlines habit or end date for habit if I want this habit for one month then automatically archive, hope to make Option to small the ring or disable it in the home page.

‏Otherwise I see that the application is very excellent and very flexible

title: Expensive
body:
in free version you're limited with:
- 3 habits only.
- No statistics.
and the subscriptions are expensive!
but the app is amazing with small size and so simple!
